headline: Last session: Sensex surged 1,718 points to 81,028, while Nifty reclaimed 25,000 amid a major bull run.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.

why: Bulls maintained strong momentum on Dalal Street for the second consecutive session
Indian stocks showed resilience by bucking a global technology sector rout
Strong buying interest in financial and automobile sectors fueled the market surge
Positive sentiment as Nifty 50 ended Samvat 2082 above the crucial 25,000 mark
whatHappening: Sensex settled at 81,028, gaining over 1,700 points in the final session of the week
Nifty 50 reclaimed the 25,000 level, finishing the last trading day at 25,030
Indian markets recorded their strongest weekly performance in the last six years
The rally followed a massive 2,009-point surge in the Sensex during the previous Thursday session
summary: The Indian stock market concluded its last session with a massive rally, with the Sensex jumping 1,718 points to close at 81,028. Nifty 50 reclaimed the 25,000 level, marking the best weekly performance for domestic indices in six years. Trading is currently paused for the weekend and is scheduled to resume on Sunday.
